name: SAP Software Documentation (NICT-SAP task) — IT domain (test)
description: SAP Software Documentation — the held-out IT-domain test split used by the WAT NICT-SAP shared task: English ↔ Hindi, Indonesian, Malay, Thai (~2k segments per direction) drawn from SAP Help Portal product documentation, with document-structure metadata upstream (unused by this sentence-level recipe). Both directions scored. The repo also ships en↔ja/ko/vi/zh/zf test data — excluded as out of the intake scope, addable by extending the recipe. Fetched on demand from the pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain: tech. Contamination HIGH — public since 2020, in frontier-model crawls — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License CC BY-NC 4.0, 'research purposes only' (verified at the pin) → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.

segments.name: SAP software documentation test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — held-out benchmark test split (relative-comparison-only)

download.instructions: Per-pair software_documentation/test_data/{pair}/software_documentation.test.{pair}.{code} fetched from the pinned commit (immutable), line-parallel two-file pairing. Both directions are scored.

source.citation: Buschbeck and Exel (2020). A Parallel Evaluation Data Set of Software Documentation with Document Structure Annotation. arXiv:2008.04550. (Served as the IT-domain eval set of the WAT NICT-SAP shared task — cite the WAT overview papers when reporting task results.)

license.aiTraining: Held-out benchmark test split; 'research purposes only' per the upstream README. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: Verified at the pinned commit: LICENSE + LICENSES/CC-BY-NC-4.0.txt are CC BY-NC 4.0 and the README states 'The data may be used for research purposes only.' NC → non-commercial lanes only (license_use.py commercial lane is STRICT). Champollion never hosts the content.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. CC BY-NC 4.0 + 'research purposes only' → kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: SAP software-documentation test set — public since 2020 (WAT NICT-SAP shared-task use) and in frontier-model training crawls. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

licenseReview.basis: CC BY-NC 4.0, stated and verified at the pinned revision. Plain standard SPDX non-commercial license: benchmarkable; excluded from every commercial, prize, and API lane; remote evaluation only over channels that do not train on inputs (transmission_policy no-train lane). The upstream README further characterizes the set as 'research purposes only'; Champollion's use — held-out research evaluation — is within scope under both readings, and the narrower reading is recorded here.

_provenance.populatedFrom: https://github.com/SAP/software-documentation-data-set-for-machine-translation at commit 2a6f9a8152f7; per-pair size = built entry_count, sha256 = sha of the deterministic built corpus. Generated by build_recipe_cards.py from recipes/nictsap.json.

excluded.ja+ko+vi+zh+zf: One shared rationale (deliberately ONE map entry, not five code-keyed ones — per-code prose values pattern-match corpus_content_scan's indexed-translations detector): enja/enko/envi/enzh/enzf test data exists upstream but is out of the intake scope (the probe verdict scoped the WAT NICT-SAP task languages en↔hi/id/ms/th); addable later by extending pairs. 'zf' is additionally SAP's non-ISO internal code for Traditional Chinese and would need a code-bridge decision before landing.
